# SiteShiftKit

SiteShiftKit is an independent collection of free browser-based website migration QA utilities and practical technical SEO guides. It is not affiliated with Google. The current utilities process user-provided text locally in the browser and do not crawl arbitrary websites or verify live HTTP status codes.

## Tools
- [URL List Comparator](https://siteshiftkit-site.onrender.com/url-list-comparator.html): Compare old and new URL inventories.
- [Redirect Map Validator](https://siteshiftkit-site.onrender.com/redirect-map-validator.html): Find duplicate redirect sources and potential chains.
- [Robots.txt Analyzer](https://siteshiftkit-site.onrender.com/robots-txt-analyzer.html): Review robots directives.
- [XML Sitemap Analyzer](https://siteshiftkit-site.onrender.com/xml-sitemap-analyzer.html): Parse XML sitemap content.
- [Canonical Tag Checker](https://siteshiftkit-site.onrender.com/canonical-tag-checker.html): Inspect canonical declarations.
- [llms.txt Generator](https://siteshiftkit-site.onrender.com/llms-txt-generator.html): Generate a Markdown page index.
